subject: Northshore treasury split — payment acceleration and VAT evidence
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12 09:32 -0500
Subject: Northshore: treasury split / payment acceleration

Team — quick summary and ask. Northshore has two outstanding invoices across different legal entities that treasury will not route in a single wire: INV-8821 (Redwood UK) and INV-8874 (Redwood EU). Total outstanding = £216,480. Their treasury has flagged an entity mismatch and is requesting separate remit instructions + EU VAT supporting docs before they release funds.

Risks:
- We lose momentum if we let this sit; they are a strategic mid-market account with predictable usage.
- VAT exposure if we accept a single payment and later have to reallocate across entities.

Proposal to move:
1) Soft dunning email (48h) to remind and outline split remit options.
2) If no firm commitment, 7-day escalation (credit hold notice + leadership cc).
3) If still no resolution, prepare legal lock and collections escalation.

Commercial levers for approval:
- Offer a one-time early-payment accelerator (3% off total if paid per proposed split within 10 days).
- Reissue the EU invoice with supplier EU VAT number or issue a credit + new invoice if tax team advises.

Can I get OK to: (a) send a firm payment-split request to Northshore treasury with attached invoices and specific remit instructions, (b) offer a 3% early-payment accelerator, and (c) loop Tax/Legal to confirm reissue path? If leadership wants a different discount or to hold off, say so.

Attachments: INV-8821-Redwood-UK.pdf, INV-8874-Redwood-EU.pdf

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber | Senior Accounts Lead, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: finance@northshorehealth.com
Cc: elena.rossi@northshorehealth.com
Date: 2026-11-13 10:05 -0500
Subject: Request: staged remit instructions & VAT evidence — INV-8821 / INV-8874

Hi Marc / Northshore treasury team,

Following up on the outstanding balance across your entities. For clarity, the invoices and suggested remit routes are attached (INV-8821 -> Redwood UK; INV-8874 -> Redwood EU). To help unblock treasury, we can accept split payments across the two entities. Proposed path: 60% remit to Redwood UK (INV-8821) by 25 Nov, remaining 40% to Redwood EU (INV-8874) by 30 Nov.

To proceed we need:
- confirmation of the accounts that treasury will use for each entity (SWIFT/IBAN),
- the EU VAT registration number for Northshore to support reverse-charge where applicable, and
- a short remittance reference per payment.

As a limited commercial concession to accelerate settlement, we are prepared to grant a one-time 3% discount on the total outstanding if payments are received per the schedule above within 10 days of agreement. If tax reissuance is needed we will coordinate with our Tax team — please confirm if you prefer a credit + reissue or a reissued EU invoice.

Attached: INV-8821-Redwood-UK.pdf, INV-8874-Redwood-EU.pdf

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Senior Accounts Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Marc Keller <marc.keller@northshorehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@northshorehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-14 14:21 +0100
Subject: Re: Request: staged remit instructions & VAT evidence — INV-8821 / INV-8874

Jonas — thanks for the clear note. Treasury has reviewed and we can do the split you outlined but require the following to release the first tranche:

1) Official supplier EU VAT registration on the EU invoice (or a credit + new EU invoice),
2) A short supplier GL description for our payment system,
3) Confirmation that Redwood will not treat the split as a write-off later (i.e., will allocate cleanly to the two legal entities).

Proposal from our side: pay 60% (GBP equivalent) to the UK entity by 25 Nov, and the remaining 40% to the EU entity by 30 Nov — we will trigger both wires if the VAT documentation is provided by 16 Nov.

Can you provide the EU VAT number and advise whether you prefer to reissue or credit/re-bill? We can accept the 3% early-payment concession if it is reflected in the invoice(s).

Thanks,
Marc Keller
Head of Treasury — Northshore Health
marc.keller@northshorehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-14 15:05 -0500
Subject: Re: Northshore treasury split — next steps and tax check

Thanks — good thread. Northshore's proposed split is workable but we need to protect revenue and tax position. Points:

- Tax: reissuing the EU invoice is safest from a VAT audit perspective. I recommend Tax reissue INV-8874 with our EU VAT number and annotate the 3% discount as an early-payment credit line on the new invoice.
- Commercial: I agree to the staged remit, but suggest offering 3% (not 5%) as Jonas proposed earlier — keeps margin and is defensible to leadership.
- Collections ops: if Northshore confirms wires by 25/30 as proposed, we will mark the account as "in remediation" but keep services active. If they miss the first commitment, we start the 7-day escalation and prepare for service restriction.

I have attached a draft amendment to the invoices for Legal/Tax review (proposed_amendment_v1.docx) and a short tax evidence checklist (tax_evidence_request.pdf) to send to Marc.

Can someone (Jonas) send the confirmed remit request + the tax checklist to Northshore and copy Tax@redwood. If Tax confirms reissue is required, Finance should be ready to reissue EU invoice and reflect the 3% line item.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Credit & Collections Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Finance Ops <finance_ops@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15 16:05 -0500
Subject: Re: Northshore treasury split — approval to proceed

All — thanks for the context and the proposed playbook. Approved:

- Proceed with the staged remit request to Northshore (60% by 25 Nov / 40% by 30 Nov).
- Offer the one-time 3% early-payment accelerator, to be applied as a line item on the reissued EU invoice.
- Tax/Legal to reissue the EU invoice immediately on receipt of Northshore's VAT number. Tax@redwood to confirm method (credit + reissue vs. reissue only) and update Finance Ops.
- Collections: mark account as "in remediation" but do not restrict service unless the first tranche is missed. If tranche 1 misses, begin the 7-day escalation and loop Legal.

Operational asks:
1) Jonas — send the remit + tax checklist to Marc and copy Tax@redwood and Finance Ops. Use HubSpot task HS-34921 for tracking.
2) Finance Ops — prepare a payment link and be ready to accept split wires; confirm IBANs when provided.

Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
